pages.text: NPCs now appear as Mortals, Cultivators, or Immortals depending on their realm. Lower realms use a few low-grade spells; higher realms can use supreme spells, immortal arts, qi flight, pills, and counter-spells.
Earth Immortal NPCs are dangerous. They may use Time Stasis, Spirit Lock, Spirit Unlock, Truth Sight Eye, Soul Mark, Buddha Fire Lotus, and passive sword aura. Keep distance and bring counters.
